verifications.claim: Coachella typically ends around 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The festival usually closes around 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday'; R3: '1am-ish on Friday & Saturday'
verifications.reasoning: Both R1 and R3 directly state the festival ends around 1 AM on Friday and Saturday.

verifications.claim: Coachella typically ends around 12:00 AM (midnight) on Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '12 a.m. on Sunday night'; R3: '12am on Sunday'
verifications.reasoning: Both R1 and R3 directly state the festival ends around 12 AM on Sunday.

verifications.claim: Coachella headliners generally start their sets between 10:00 PM and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Headliners usually come on around 10-11 PM each day'
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly supports headliners starting around 10-11 PM, applicable to Friday and Saturday.

verifications.claim: Coachella shuttles usually run for up to one hour after the final set ends.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Any Line Shuttles end outbound service one hour after the music stops'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states shuttles run one hour after music (final set) stops.
